diagnostic.syntax1: I-JSON iqukethe uhlamvu olungasekelwa. Hlola izimpawu zokuloba, izimpawu zokucaphuna nezinhlamvu ezingabonakali.
diagnostic.syntax2: Inombolo ayivumelekile. Sebenzisa indlela yezinombolo ye-JSON, njengokuthi -12, 0.5 noma 1e3.
diagnostic.syntax3: Amagama ezakhiwo kufanele abe phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna ezimbili. Ngemva kokhiye ocashuniwe, faka ikholoni nenani.
diagnostic.syntax4: Inani le-JSON alikho. Faka into, uhlu, iyunithi yombhalo, inombolo, true, false noma null; susa noma iyiphi ikhomana yokugcina.
diagnostic.syntax5: Ikholoni ayikho ngemva kwegama lesakhiwo. Faka : phakathi kokhiye nenani lawo.
diagnostic.syntax6: Ikhomana ayikho phakathi kwezakhiwo noma izinto zohlu. Faka , phakathi kwezinto ezilandelanayo.
diagnostic.syntax7: Ubakaki ogoqekile wokuvala awukho. Faka } ovala into.
diagnostic.syntax8: Ubakaki oyisikwele wokuvala awukho. Faka ] ovala uhlu.
diagnostic.syntax9: Kunokuqukethwe okwengeziwe ngemva kwenani eliyimpande. Gcina inani elilodwa eliyimpande noma ufake amanani amaningi ohlwini.
diagnostic.syntax10: I-JSON ejwayelekile ayiwasekeli amazwana. Susa amazwana e-// noma e-/* */.
diagnostic.syntax11: Amazwana awavaliwe. I-JSON ejwayelekile ayiwasekeli amazwana; susa lawo mazwana.
diagnostic.syntax12: Iyunithi yombhalo ayivaliwe. Faka uphawu lokucaphuna lokugcina bese usebenzisa izimpawu zokubalekisa ezimpawini zokucaphuna ezingaphakathi.
diagnostic.syntax13: Inombolo ayiphelele. Amachashazi edesimali nama-eksponenti kufanele alandelwe amadijithi.
diagnostic.syntax14: Uphawu lokubalekisa lwe-Unicode aluvumelekile. Sebenzisa \u olandelwa amadijithi amane e-hexadecimal.
diagnostic.syntax15: Uphawu lokubalekisa embhalweni aluvumelekile. Ngemva kwe-\, sebenzisa kuphela uphawu lokucaphuna, \, /, b, f, n, r, t noma u.
diagnostic.syntax16: Uhlamvu lokulawula alunalo uphawu lokubalekisa. Sebenzisa \n, \r no-\t ngomugqa omusha, ukubuyela ekuqaleni komugqa nethebhu.
diagnostic.DuplicateKey: Igama lesakhiwo liphindaphindiwe. Okhiye kufanele bahluke ngaphakathi kwento eyodwa.
diagnostic.EmptyInput: Okufakiwe akunalutho. Namathisela noma ngenisa i-JSON ukuze uqhathanise.
diagnostic.TaskFailed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqedwa. Zama futhi; uma inkinga iqhubeka, layisha kabusha ithuluzi.
diagnostic.NestingLimit: Amazinga okungena ngaphakathi kwe-JSON maningi kakhulu. Nciphisa amazinga noma uhlukanise idatha.
diagnostic.SizeLimit: Idatha yeqa amandla okucubungula esiphequluli. Hlukanisa ifayela noma ukhulule izinsiza zesiphequluli.
diagnostic.InvalidEncoding: Ifayela alikho ku-UTF-8 evumelekile. Ligcine njenge-UTF-8 bese ulingenisa futhi.

uiText.s45753be7: Ubude bezinhlamvu kufanele bube yinombolo ukusuka ku-4 ukuya ku-256.
uiText.s336fff1e: Ubuningi kufanele bube inombolo ephelele ukusuka ku-1 kuye ku-100.
uiText.s3692160: Isigaba esikhethiwe asinalutho ngemva kokukhishwa. Lungisa okukhishiwe noma ungakhethi leso sigaba.
uiText.s142e4a2a: Ubude bufushane kakhulu ukuthi bungakwazi ukufaka wonke amakilasi akhethiwe.
uiText.sa46b697: Sebenzisa i-ASCII ephrintekayo kuphela, okungenani nezinhlamvu ezimbili ezihlukene ezisele ngemva kokukhishwa.
uiText.s6cc5d6f3: Umthombo ongahleliwe ovikelekile wesiphequluli sakho awutholakali.
uiText.s4bf2a846: Ayikwazanga ukwanelisa imikhawulo phakathi kokutonyulwa kwe-10000. Lungisa amakilasi noma okungafakwanga bese uzama futhi.
uiText.s408a6633: Isibalo samagama kufanele sibe inombolo ephelele ukusuka ku-4 kuye ku-12.
uiText.se1713583: Khetha isikhala, ihayifeni, noma isihlukanisi se-underscore.
uiText.sc7371574: Ukuqinisekisa uhlu lwamagama endawo kwehlulekile. Ukwenziwa komushwana wokungena akutholakali.
uiText.sfea4083e: Ukwenziwa kwephasiwedi kuhlulekile. Hlola izinketho bese uzama futhi.
uiText.safc95ee5: I-{{p0}} ikhiqizwa. Kopisha noma landa ngokwenza.
uiText.s645065e7: Chofoza okuthi Khiqiza ukuze udale imiphumela.
uiText.s20bd3702: Khiqiza ngokudingeka ngomthombo ongahleliwe ovikelekile wesiphequluli sakho, endaweni yonke.
uiText.s14932c20: Faka okungenani uhlamvu olulodwa ekilasini ngalinye elikhethiwe
uiText.s28a4b316: Sebenzisa i-alfabhethi yangokwezifiso (ibhala ngaphezulu izidingo zekilasi)
uiText.s7150f798: I-ASCII ephrintekayo kuphela (kuhlanganise nezikhala). Okungenani izinhlamvu ezimbili ezihlukene kufanele zisale ngemva kokukhishwa.
uiText.s9c482d76: Ungafaki izinhlamvu ezingaqondakali 0 O 1 l I
uiText.s62ada1af: Ukuzimela kudonsa ohlwini lwendawo lwamagama angu-EFF 7776, namagama aphindaphindiwe avunyelwe. Amagama ayisithupha ngokuzenzakalelayo. Amagama ambalwa okuqala aqukethe amakhonco.
uiText.s19345554: Isebenza kuphela uma uchofoza okuthi Khiqiza, ngaphandle kokukopisha okuzenzakalelayo. Ipharamitha ishintsha imiphumela ecacile emidala. Ukushiya ikhasi kusula imiphumela yamanje; awukho umlando ogciniwe.
uiText.s97298d85: Okokufaka kudlula i-10 MiB; ukuhlela akuzange kusetshenziswe
uiText.s58b78d61: Ukushintshwa kudlula i-16 KiB; ukuhlela akuzange kusetshenziswe
uiText.sad2bc38e: Kufinyeziwe: kugcinwa okufanayo kokuqala okungu-10000 kuphela. Ukukhipha/JSON kusebenzisa okugcinwe; ukushintsha kuvaliwe.
uiText.s698d5880: Okugqamile kukhawulelwe ku-1000; konke okufanayo kuhlala kukwazi ukuzulazula.
uiText.s1c6d1b0: Ukubuka kuqala kwe-1 MiB kuphela; ukukopisha/ukulanda kusebenzisa umphumela ogcwele
uiText.s7ce236cc: JavaScript RegExp · Ukufanisa kwasendaweni, ukukhishwa nokushintshwa
uiText.s48b64467: $$ → $ · $& → konke okufanayo · $1…$99 → iqembu elinenombolo · $<name> → iqembu elinegama · $\x60 / $' → umbhalo ongaphambi / ongemva. Amaqembu angabambanga aba izintambo ezingenalutho; ikhodi ayisetshenziswa.
uiText.s2c32a032: Okufakwayo ≤ 10 MiB · Iphethini/okushintshwayo ngakunye ≤ 16 KiB · Okuphumayo ≤ 100 MiB · Umkhawulo imizuzwana 2 · Okuzenzakalelayo ≤ 256 KiB ngemva kuka-350 ms; umbhalo omkhulu usebenze mathupha.
uiText.se75dfc0b: Igqamisa kufika kumameshi ayi-1000. Imigqa/amakholomu aqala ku-1; ama-offset aqala ku-0. Amakholomu nama-offset abala amayunithi ekhodi angu-UTF-16.
uiText.s766669f0: Inani lethebula ngalinye lihlola kuqala izinhlamvu ezifika kwezi-2000. I-JSON igcina amanani agcwele; I-defined / null ihlukanisa ukuthwebula okungahlanganyeli kochungechunge olungenalutho. 50 okufanayo ekhasini ngalinye; Uphequlula odlule/Okulandelayo konke okufanayo okugciniwe.
uiText.s1fd087ec: Ukukhetha umthetho kushintsha iphethini namafulegi kuphela. Amanothi namasampula okwenziwa yizithenjwa. Ukufana kwefomethi kufakazela ubuqiniso, ukufaneleka noma ukuphepha.
uiText.sf4dd052c: Noma yimuphi uhlamvu / idijithi, uhlamvu lwegama, indawo emhlophe
uiText.s6e50e010: Isici Unicode; kudingeka u noma v
uiText.s4db267f9: g konke · i ungahlukanisi izinhlamvu · m amahange emigqa eminingi · s dotAll · u Unicode · v amasethi Unicode · y indawo yamanje · d izinkomba zamaqembu. u / v akuhlangani; ukwesekwa kuya ngesiphequluli. Ngaphandle kwe-g kugcinwa okufanayo kokuqala; y isadinga indawo yamanje.
uiText.sd7adf1e7: Ezinye izinjini (Java / Python / PCRE) zingasebenzisa i-syntax ehlukile. Amaphethini ayinkimbinkimbi angahlehla kancane; imisebenzi eyenziwa nge-Worker ehlukile, inqanyulwa lapho ikhanseliwe noma okokufaka kushintsha.
uiText.s95664be2: Umbhalo wekhodi, amafomethi nokuguqulwa kwebhayithi. Okungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ngokuphelele.
uiText.sf9c5b22: Umbhalo othi 10 MiB · Ifayela 50 MiB · Okukhiphayo 100 MiB
uiText.sa10a6e3c: Ilondoloza amabhayithi angahluziwe. Qalisa mathupha ngemva kokungenisa.
uiText.s8a746896: Umbhalo weqa i-10 MiB; ukuhlela akuzange kusetshenziswe
uiText.sb4b12946: Ukubuka kuqala kwe-1 MiB; ukukopisha/ukulanda kusebenzisa umphumela ogcwele
uiText.sfc1b6be8: Ilungele ukusebenza. Amafayela nemibhalo engaphezu kuka-256 KiB isebenza mathupha.
uiText.s620fdc4d: Ukuhlola kuqala ifayela kuhlulekile; khetha ifayela futhi
uiText.s997fe268: Ibhodi lokunamathisela alitholakali. Landa umphumela ogcwele kunalokho.
uiText.se64a1707: Umphumela weqa umkhawulo wombhalo we-10 MiB; landa futhi ungenise njengamabhayithi
uiText.sdbb3f38a: Amasampula esivinini sokulanda nokulayisha. I-eksisi eqondile: {{p0}}. Evundlile: inombolo yesampula.
uiText.s176420f6: Qala ukuhlola ukuze ubone ishadi lesivinini
uiText.sb9fe0560: Awekho amasampula esivinini arekhodiwe. Zama okunye ukuhlola.
uiText.scf6db0aa: Ukulayisha okuhleliwe okufika cishe ku-{{p0}} MiB; ukuthunyelwa kabusha kungase kwengeze ithrafikhi. Umkhawulo wamasekhondi angu-120. Khansela noma kunini.
uiText.sa3aafdbb: Kala mathupha ukulanda, ukulayisha kanye nokubambezeleka kwe-HTTP endaweni yomphakathi.
uiText.saecdb926: Qala kuphela exhuma ku-speed.cloudflare.com. Isevisi ithola i-IP yakho nethrafikhi yokuhlola yokwenziwa. Ayithumeli idatha yamanye amathuluzi, imininingwane yokungena noma imibiko eyengeziwe. Amaphutha enodi abikwa ngqo.
uiText.sc847ed18: Iphuzu ngalinye liyisampula yesivinini esicelweni esiqediwe. Landa futhi ulayishe sebenzisa izinombolo zabo zesampula.
uiText.s18bb5cac: Idatha yamasampula aqediwe ayihlanganisi izindleko zephrothokholi, izicelo ezihlulekile, idatha esadluliswa nokuthumela kabusha. Imodi elula ingase ingalinganisi ngokugcwele uxhumano olusheshayo. Ukubambezeleka kusebenzisa HTTP, hhayi ICMP ping. Ukulahleka kwamaphakethe UDP akulinganiswa.
uiText.sef4b0125: Ukuqaqa ikhodi kukhiqiza amabhayithi. Isethi yezinhlamvu ilawula ukubhala ikhodi yombhalo nokubuka okuqaqiwe. Imikhawulo yomtapo Base58: amabhayithi aluhlaza 2 KiB / umbhalo obhalwe ikhodi 4 KiB.
uiText.sc023193a: Okokufaka akukaze kwenziwe. Izingxenye zefomu zisebenzisa i-+ ezikhaleni; Izingxenye ze-URL zisebenzisa i-%20 futhi zifaka ikhodi ethi + njenge-%2B.
uiText.s60f198fc: Okokufaka umbhalo sekuvele kungu-Unicode; umbhalo wekhodi womthombo uyasebenza kumafayela. I-BOM neziphetho zomugqa zigciniwe. Izinhlamvu ezingavumelekile noma ezingameleleki zidala iphutha.
uiText.sb1f912c3: Idokhumenti eyodwa ye-YAML 1.2 kusetshenziswa imodeli yedatha ye-JSON. Iziteketiso ziboshelwe. Imijikelezo, izinhlobo ezikhethekile, okhiye abayizimpinda noma abangenazintambo bayanqatshwa. Amazwana nesakhiwo akulondoloziwe.
uiText.sa2b3dc74: Isebenzisa i-fast-xml-parser efana ne-oda: izibaluli kokuthi :@ nombhalo kokuthi #text. Ukuguqulwa kokuhlehla kudinga lesi sakhiwo. I-DTD nezinhlangano zangaphandle azivunyelwe. Isakhiwo somthombo asilondoloziwe.
uiText.sb34c6af0: Amaseli ahlala eyiyunithi yezinhlamvu ngokuzenzakalelayo. Izihloko eziyimpinda, amakholomu angahambisani noma izinkambu ezingekho ziyehluleka. I-Null/amanani afakiwe adinga imodi yeseli ye-JSON ecacile. Amazwana nesakhiwo akulondoloziwe.
uiText.s8e21362d: Umugqa ngamunye uyinani eliqinile le-JSON elinezinombolo ezingalahleki. Imigqa engenalutho iyahluleka; isiphetho somugqa wokugcina sivunyelwe.
uiText.s680be70a: Imephu yokhiye ngamunye eya kuchungechunge lweyunithi yezinhlamvu ezingenalutho, igcina amapharamitha aphindaphindiwe namanani angenalutho. I-+ isho indawo. Isitayela sokuqala sombhalo wekhodi asilondoloziwe.
uiText.s3e77450f: Bala futhi uqhathanise amasheke e-MD5 ombhalo namafayela, okuhlanganisa amaqoqo omugqa kanye ne-HMAC. Okwasendaweni ngokuphelele.
uiText.s7db48bc4: I-Hashes amabhayithi angempela ngaphandle kokusikwa noma izinguquko zomugqa omusha. I-MD5, i-SHA-1 ne-CRC32 ezokusebenzisana/ukuhlola, hhayi amasiginesha okuphepha.
uiText.sd25a27b: Okhiye basetshenziselwa umsebenzi wamanje kuphela futhi abalokothi balondolozwe. Isulwe ngemva kokuqedwa, ukukhansela noma ukushiya ithuluzi.
uiText.s58f4da86: Ukuqaqa ikhodi kuphela; isiginesha AYIQINISEKISWA. JWT enezingxenye ezintathu kuphela. Ukuqaqa akufakazeli ubuqiniso noma ukwethenjwa. JWE enezingxenye ezinhlanu idinga ukususa ukubethela.
uiText.s838cf858: Okufakwayo okuluhlaza kugcina amabhayithi. Ukukhipha ukucindezela kunqunyelwa ku-100 MiB ngesinyathelo ngasinye futhi kuhlola ubuqotho bokugeleza. Gzip yamukela i-member eyodwa; ukugeleza okuhlanganisiwe kuyenqatshwa.
uiText.sdbcbabef: Izisekelo 2–36 nge-BigInt, kufika kumadijithi 10,000. Izinombolo eziphelele kuphela, nezimpawu neziqalo ezifanele 0b / 0o / 0x.
uiText.sb8a72fd: b = amabhithi; B = amabhayithi. MB = 1000² B; MiB = 1024² B. Ukubala amadijithi 200; ukubonisa abalulekile 30. ≈ kusho ukusondeza inani.
uiText.s72deec74: Ubude obungaguquki; Usuku olu-1 = amahora angama-24. Sebenzisa ithuluzi lesitembu sesikhathi samadethi. ≈ amamaki ukuzungezisa.
uiText.sfa53efae: Faka i-HEX / RGB / HSL noma i-HSV JSON {"h":120,"s":100,"v":100,"a":0.5}. U-Alpha ugciniwe; ukuguqulwa kubandakanya ukulinganisa.
uiText.sc6b7a6f7: Isebenza kuphela ukuguqulwa okukhethiwe. Izitayela zokuqamba zisebenzisa imingcele yamagama engu-change-case.
uiText.s44ff1312: Kusetshenziswa umsebenzi okhethiwe kuphela. Azikho izinguquko ezengeziwe kuzinhlamvu ezinkulu/ofeleba abancane, indawo emhlophe noma imigqa emisha.
uiText.s7124e44b: Ishintsha ngokusobala ukumelwa kwamaphoyinti ekhodi Unicode. NFKC / NFKD kuguqula izinhlamvu zokuhambisana zibe isimo esijwayelekile.
uiText.se5cd09b1: Akuyona i-RFC ephelele, i-imeyili yamazwe ngamazwe noma isiqinisekisi sokulethwa
uiText.s7045c16a: Ayiqinisekisi umsingathi, imbobo noma umbhalo wekhodi; sebenzisa i-URL API ukuze uhlukanise ngokuphelele
uiText.s2acd58b1: Ihlola ama-octet amadesimali amane kububanzi obungu-0–255
uiText.s638f0191: Awekho ama-zero aholayo, i-CIDR noma ukuhlola ukufinyeleleka
uiText.s9d2e8b17: Ihlola ikheli le-IPv6 elinamaqembu ayisishiyagalombili, ngaphandle kokucindezelwa
uiText.sa8d453a1: Akukho ukucindezelwa kwe-::, okushumekiwe kwe-IPv4, i-ID yendawo noma i-CIDR
uiText.scf0860a8: Ihlola umumo ojwayelekile wenombolo yeselula enezinhlamvu eziyi-11
uiText.s65b4ed60: Isimo kuphela; akukho sabelo, ubunikazi noma ukuhlola ubukhona
uiText.s39634548: Ihlola ikhodi yendawo enoziro nenombolo yendawo
uiText.s79c21575: Kuhlukaniswe ihayifeni kuphela; asikho isandiso noma ukuqinisekiswa kwangempela kwekhodi yendawo
uiText.sfab4758e: Ihlola ukwakheka okujwayelekile kwezinhlamvu eziyi-18 kanye nebanga lenkundla yedethi
uiText.s4889e08b: Akubhekwa isifunda, usuku lwangempela noma checksum; akufakazeli ubuwena. Izibonelo zenziwe
uiText.sb601c5e2: Ihlola umumo wekhodi yeposi enezinombolo eziyisithupha ezinedijithi yokuqala engeyona eyero
uiText.s2b0a65f6: Ayihloli izifunda zokulethwa noma ukunikezwa kwekhodi
uiText.s3017dbf5: Ihlola unyaka, inyanga nosuku lwenkundla yomumo nobubanzi
uiText.se422efb4: Alikho isheke le-leap-year noma izinsuku-ngenyanga; I-2026-02-31 nayo iyahambelana
uiText.s34bf5e44: Ayikho indawo yesikhathi, amasekhondi ayingxenye, 24:00 noma gxuma isekhondi
uiText.sc41d1fcb: Ihlola isitembu sesikhathi se-ISO esivamile esinendawo yesikhathi
uiText.s3e43e895: Ayiqinisekisi amadethi angempela noma izinhlanganisela ze-offset; ayiqedi i-ISO 8601
uiText.s6af39278: Asikho isheke lokunemba noma uhla lwezinombolo eziphephile; I--0 ivunyelwe
uiText.s9980e7fd: Ayikho i-exponent, izihlukanisi eziyizinkulungwane, i-.5 noma i-1.; akukho ukuhlola ukunemba
uiText.sf7fc4c4d: Imibala ye-Hex CSS kuphela; awekho amagama ombala noma i-rgb()
uiText.sb626f901: Akubhekwa inguqulo, uhlobo noma ukuhluka; nil UUID ivumelekile
uiText.s659ade23: Amakholoni kuphela; akukho ukuhlola komthengisi noma ukwabiwa kwekheli
uiText.sc87d549d: Alikho ichashazi elilandelanayo, i-Unicode noma wonke ama-punycode TLD; Idatha ye-DNS
uiText.sdbffc094: Ama-ASCII slug avamile kuphela; akukho Unicode noma slash
uiText.sdeafdf47: Ihlola izinombolo zenguqulo ezintathu ezinezihlonzi ozikhethela zokukhishwa kusengaphambili/zokwakha
uiText.sae7a9d17: Ivumela oziro abaholayo kuzihlonzi zezinombolo ezikhishwe ngaphambilini; ayiqedi i-SemVer 2
uiText.s4532a1c0: Ihlola igama lomsebenzisi elinezinhlamvu ezingu-3–32 kuqala ngohlamvu
uiText.s199c7040: Isibonelo senqubomgomo; akukho okuhlukile, igama eligodliwe noma isheke le-Unicode
uiText.s9b8bb945: Ihlola izinhlamvu ezingu-8–64 eziphrintekayo ze-ASCII ezinosonhlamvukazi abaphezulu/abancane, idijithi nophawu
uiText.sfd7a117: Lokhu kubonisa kuphela inqubomgomo yabalingiswa, hhayi ukuhlola ukuphepha. Ungafaki iphasiwedi yangempela.
uiText.s561a20: I-Han ayikhawulelwe kusiShayina Esenziwe Lula; izimpawu zokuloba azifakiwe
uiText.s84f2d60c: Kufaka phakathi imigqa emisha kanye ne-Unicode emhlophe, hhayi izikhala kuphela
uiText.s50713cef: Ifanisa imigqa engenalutho equkethe amathebhu noma izikhala kuphela
uiText.s257dfe7d: LF/CRLF kuphela; ingase ikhiqize ukufana kobude obuyiziro ekugcineni
uiText.s910136fe: Hhayi umhlaziyi we-HTML, umhlaseli wemfanelo ecashuniwe noma isicoci; sebenzisa umhlaseli we-HTML
uiText.s6669e324: Ikhipha izixhumanisi ze-inline HTTP(S) ezilula; ithwebula umbhalo kanye ne-URL
uiText.sf98428c0: Azikho izidleke, ukubaleka, izihloko noma izixhumanisi eziyisethenjwa
uiText.sdd368a90: Imonyula izintambo zomugqa owodwa ocashuniwe kabili ngokubaleka kwe-backslash
uiText.sc441ea3f: Akuqinisekisi noma kuqaqe ukulandelana kwe-escape JSON/JS
uiText.s55f985c: Ihlola umugqa owodwa ohlukaniswe ngekhoma onezindawo zokubalekela eziphindwe kabili
uiText.s7e3f7ecd: Azikho izinkambu ze-multiline, ezinye i-delimiters noma amafayela aphelele; sebenzisa umhlaseli we-CSV
uiText.sd154b69: Imonyula amaleveli elogi yofeleba abakhulu abavamile
uiText.s61a28f6b: Imingcele yamagama kuphela; ayincozululi ukwakheka kwelogi noma i-ERROR_CODE
uiText.s22f2a0f: Akukho ukunemba noma ukuhlola kobubanzi obunomkhawulo; akusona umhlahleli we-JSON ogcwele
uiText.durationReset: Ukushintsha ubude besikhathi ngenkathi kumisiwe kusetha kabusha ukubala wehle.

ux.purpose_text: Hlela izinhlu, khipha ulwazi futhi ufihle ulwazi embhalweni.

hex.usage: Guqula amabhayithi aye noma asuke ku-hexadecimal.

binary.usage: Mela ibhayithi ngalinye ngamadijithi ayisishiyagalombili kanambambili.

url-component.usage: Faka ikhodi kupharamitha eyodwa ye-URL noma engxenyeni yendlela.
url-component.help: Isebenzisa i-encodeURIComponent / decodeURIComponent. Izikhala ziba u-%20; uphawu + loqobo luba u-%2B.

uri.usage: Faka ikhodi yokuphunyuka kuyo yonke i-URI ugcine izihlukanisi zayo.
uri.help: Isebenzisa i-encodeURI / decodeURI futhi igcina izihlukanisi ze-URI ezinjengo-: / ? #. Ngenani elilodwa lepharamitha, sebenzisa ingxenye ye-URL.

form.usage: Faka ikhodi kukhiye owodwa noma enanini lefomu.
form.help: Ilandela imithetho ye-application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Izikhala ziba u-+; uphawu + loqobo luba u-%2B.

html-entities.usage: Faka ikhodi yokuphunyuka ezinhlamvini ezikhethekile zokuqukethwe kwe-HTML.
html-entities.help: Ifaka futhi ikhiphe ikhodi yokuphunyuka ezintweni ze-HTML. Iguqula umbhalo ngaphandle kokuhlaziya noma ukusebenzisa i-HTML.

xml-entities.usage: Guqula umbhalo uye noma usuke ezintweni ze-XML.
xml-entities.help: Ifaka futhi ikhiphe ikhodi yokuphunyuka ezintweni ze-XML ngaphandle kokuhlaziya idokhumenti ye-XML noma ukusebenzisa okufakiwe.

json-string.usage: Dala noma ufunde umbhalo oqondile ophelele weyunithi yezinhlamvu ye-JSON.
json-string.help: Umphumela onekhodi uqukethe izimpawu zokucaphuna ezizungezile. Ukukhipha ikhodi kudinga umbhalo oqondile ophelele weyunithi yezinhlamvu ye-JSON.

unicode.usage: Guqula umbhalo uye noma usuke ekuphunyukeni kwe-Unicode.
unicode.help: Ifaka ikhodi ku-UTF-16 njengokuphunyuka kwe-\uXXXX. Ikhipha ikhodi yolimi lokuphunyuka olusekelwayo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa okufakiwe.

codepoints.usage: Hlola noma wakhe kabusha amaphuzu ekhodi e-Unicode.
codepoints.help: Ifaka ikhodi ohlwini lwamaphuzu ekhodi e-U+ e-hexadecimal. Ukukhipha ikhodi kwakha umbhalo kabusha, kuhlanganise nezinhlamvu ezengeziwe.

charset.usage: Faka ikhodi kumabhayithi ngesethi yezinhlamvu eqondiwe.

xml-json.usage: Guqula i-XML nesakhiwo sayo se-JSON esihlelekile.

query-json.usage: Guqula amapharamitha ombuzo aphindaphindayo abe yizinhlu zeyunithi yezinhlamvu.
query-json.output: Into ye-JSON equkethe izinhlu zeyunithi yezinhlamvu

md5.usage: Bala isamba sokuhlola se-MD5 bese uqhathanisa amanani alindelekile.

hash.usage: Bala i-hash yamabhayithi okuqala ombhalo noma ifayela.

jwt.usage: Funda izihloko nokuqukethwe kwe-JWT ngaphandle kokuqinisekisa amasiginesha.

gzip.usage: Cindezela noma uvule umfudlana owodwa we-Gzip.

deflate.usage: Cindezela noma uvule idatha eluhlaza ye-Deflate.

radix.usage: Guqula inombolo ephelele iye kwesinye isisekelo.

bytes-unit.usage: Guqula amabhithi, amabhayithi namayunithi e-SI ne-IEC.

duration-unit.usage: Guqula izikhathi ezimisiwe ngaphandle kokubala ikhalenda.

case.usage: Sebenzisa usayizi wezinhlamvu noma isitayela sokuqamba esikhethiwe.

lines.usage: Sebenzisa isenzo esisodwa esikhethiwe emigqeni yombhalo.

errors.CsvColumns: Umugqa {{row}} unamakholomu angu-{{actual}}; kulindeleke angu-{{expected}}. Hlola izihlukanisi namaseli akuzimpawu zokucaphuna.
errors.CsvHeaders: Amagama amakholomu ayaphindaphindwa. Waqambe kabusha noma uvale umugqa wesihloko.
errors.CsvJsonCell: Umugqa {{row}}, ikholomu {{column}} ayinayo i-JSON evumelekile. Sebenzisa inani le-JSON noma ukhethe imodi yamaseli eyiyunithi yezinhlamvu.
errors.CsvArrayHeader: Imigqa engama-array ayinawo amagama amakholomu. Vala umugqa wesihloko.
errors.CsvNestedValue: null namanani angaphakathi kwamanye adinga imodi yamaseli yokwenziwa kwe-serial kwe-JSON okucacile.
errors.CsvRowShape: Umugqa ngamunye we-JSON kufanele ube namakholomu afanayo ngaphandle kwamanani angekho.
errors.XmlOrdered: Sebenzisa i-array yamanodi ahleliwe evela ku-XML → JSON. Layisha isibonelo ukuze ubone izibaluli namanodi ombhalo.

notices.StructureOnly: Amanani edatha nesakhiwo esisekelwayo kuyagcinwa; amazwana omthombo, ukufometha nesitayela sezimpawu zokucaphuna akugcinwa.
notices.CsvStrings: Amaseli e-CSV ahlala engamayunithi ezinhlamvu; izinombolo namanani e-boolean akuqagelwa ngokuzenzakalela.
notices.CsvTextExport: I-CSV ingumbhalo; ukuthumela okuzenzakalelayo akugcini imininingwane yohlobo lwamanani angawodwa e-JSON.
